faq_heading: Homes near Yale Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Yale Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Abbotsford School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Yale Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Yale Secondary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Yale Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 365 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,019,100, townhomes $642,450, condos $360,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Yale Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Yale Secondary the median was 25 days on the market, closing at 97.6% of the list price, with 7% of sales above the list price for the 365 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Yale Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are William A. Fraser Middle School (0.2 km south), McMillan Elementary (0.5 km south-east) and Margaret Stenersen Elementary (1.2 km north).

Yale Secondary is a secondary school in Abbotsford (Abbotsford School District), at 34620 Old Yale Rd. It teaches grades 9 to 12. Programs listed: Baseball Academy; Softball Academy.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Yale Secondary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 2 km of the school.
How the Yale Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Yale Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Yale Secondary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 365 homes sold within 2 km of Yale Secondary: 175 houses, 106 townhomes and 58 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,019,100.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Yale Secondary

14 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Yale Secondary in a straight line (6 elementary, 3 middle, 3 other, 2 secondary; 2 independent). The closest is William A. Fraser Middle School, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is Abbotsford Middle School, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is McMillan Elementary (0.5 km); the nearest secondary school is Robert Bateman Secondary (2.6 km); the nearest independent school is Abbotsford Christian School (1.9 km). Other secondary schools close by: Robert Bateman Secondary (2.6 km north), Abbotsford Senior Secondary School (2.6 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (9-12) is Robert Bateman Secondary, 2.6 km north of Yale Secondary.
